<DIV align="center" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><U><B>Effects of the 2011 Earthquake off the Pacific Coast of Tohoku (3)</B></U><BR>
(Some plants resume production.)
</DIV>


<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt">We at the Komatsu Group hereby extend our sincere condolences to the people who have been adversely
affected by the earthquake and Tsunami which occurred on March&nbsp;11, 2011 and to their relatives as
well.
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt; text-indent: 5%">We are beginning to start production gradually at our plants in the areas affected by the
earthquake. The latest conditions are described below.
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>1.&nbsp;Employees and their families</B><BR>
We have confirmed the safety of all employees of the Komatsu Group. However, there are a few
employees who cannot confirm the safety of their family members and relatives. As our top priority
task, we are continuing to look into their safety.
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>2.&nbsp;Sales, service and other bases in the affected area</B><BR>
As reported in the news release of March&nbsp;14, some bases in the Tohoku area have been seriously
damaged by tsunami. We believe it will take some time for their full recovery to normal levels of
operation. In this area, we are supporting affected employees to rebuild the foundation of their
daily living, while starting assistance to reconstruction of the affected areas.
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>3.&nbsp;Production</B><BR>
1) We are making progress in repairs and inspection at our plants in the affected areas, and we are
beginning to gradually resume production at these plants. (See the next page for more information.)
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt">2) Concerning our suppliers who have been adversely affected, we are continuing our support of
their inspection and repairs of facilities and equipment for their recovery. However, we are
anticipating that our procurement of parts and so forth will remain unstable into the next and
following weeks.
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt">3) Although we are projecting that our production will be affected by a variety of factors, such as
future power supply in the affected areas, aftershock possibility and the nuclear plant problem in
Fukushima, we are making group-wide efforts for full recovery of our operations.
</DIV>
<P align="center" style="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;

<P align="center" style="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Folio -->&nbsp;<!-- /Folio -->
</DIV>

<!-- PAGEBREAK -->
<P><HR noshade><P>
<H5 align="left" style="page-break-before:always">&nbsp;</H5><P>

<DIV style="font-family: 'Times New Roman',Times,serif; margin-left: .25in; width: 7.50in">

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt">4.&nbsp;Business results for the current fiscal year (ending March&nbsp;31, 2011)<BR>
While we are going to record unexpected expenses related to these recovery efforts, we are
projecting that these expenses will have only small impact on the business results.
</DIV>
